exposure: Delayed amniotomy (ROM > 8 h after oxytocin initiation)
cohort: 2081 women with a viable, singleton gestation who underwent labor induction at a tertiary-care hospital (4/2014-3/2017)
finding: Delayed amniotomy >8 h after starting oxytocin for labor induction was associated with higher odds of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Delayed amniotomy during labor induction was associated with higher odds of cesarean delivery, particularly in women with increasing body mass index.
